prevents.Typography: Raw font-size, font-weight, font-family, or text rendered without semantic hierarchy.
prevents.Spacing: Arbitrary margin/padding on child elements and hardcoded flex/grid gaps.
prevents.Iconography: Emoji fallbacks, arbitrary glyphs, inline SVGs without semantic role, and unlabeled icon-only actions.
prevents.Color: Raw hex values, decorative color choices, and status color used without meaning.
prevents.Density: Public component size props, local compact/comfortable flags, and density that changes spacing without type, icon, focus, loading, disabled, and breakpoint behavior.
prevents.fallbackTemplate: Hardcoded {{titleLower}} values and one-off implementation behavior.
